extracted.name: Mango cheesecake cake
extracted.description: Thinking outside the box...starting to play with boxed cakes again.
ingredient_lines: 1 (3.4 oz.) box jello cream cheese flavored instant pudding mix
1 (1 oz.) Pkg. Freeze dried mangos - chopped
instruction_lines: Add butter and vanilla and blend well
Grease and flour desired bundt pan
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.
Frost with desired Frosting. I was being lazy and used canned Frosting
